title: Jesus... My Bible App Says 412 Days 📖
topic: her Bible app says it has been 412 days since she last read, and she swiped the reminder away in shame

bible.text: Simon Peter replied, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my Bible app says 412 days since I last read. I swiped the reminder away. 📖

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: At church everyone quotes verses. I nod like I remember them.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You didn't swipe Me away. You swiped away the shame.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: It feels too late to start again.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Peter denied knowing Me three times. I still made him breakfast.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Read one verse today. That isn't starting late. That's coming home.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend who stopped reading but never stopped believing. 📖
